item.title: About
item.description:
Experienced engineer and infrastructure manager with more than 10 years in IT and 7+ years of full ownership of a product platform - from a single physical server to a fault-tolerant VMware-based cloud and Kubernetes. I specialize in building and evolving infrastructure from scratch, process automation, CI/CD and increasing system reliability.

I develop tools on Python, Golang and JavaScript: ChatOps-bot, contribute to open-source projects - everything that help developers focus on the product, not on the routine.
